title: CalloutInputWindow: restore HWND_TOPMOST -- IntPtr.Zero workaround now obsolete
desc: SetWindowPos in callout used HWND_TOP (IntPtr.Zero) instead of HWND_TOPMOST since dbb715282, causing callout to appear behind other windows. The workaround is obsolete now that MonitorFromWindow guard handles the ghost-window case.
steps: SYMPTOM: Callout window (wkappbot taskkill confirmation, suggest callout etc.) appears behind other windows instead of on top.

ROOT CAUSE: dbb715282 (2026-05-03) changed SetWindowPos hWndInsertAfter from HWND_TOPMOST(-1) to HWND_TOP(0/IntPtr.Zero) to avoid ghost windows during taskkill teardown. 3d92ec0ac documented the rationale. d8cb39bfb trimmed the comment.

WHY WORKAROUND OBSOLETE: same dbb715282 added MonitorFromWindow guard that detects off-screen windows and re-snaps them. WS_EX_NOACTIVATE also prevents focus-steal ghost. The IntPtr.Zero workaround no longer needed.
FIX: change all 3 SetWindowPos hWndInsertAfter to (IntPtr)(-1) in CalloutInputWindow.cs:226,280 and CalloutInputWindow.Ctor.cs:206.
VERIFY: wkappbot taskkill /IM notepad.exe -- callout appears on top of all windows. Run it while a maximized window is active.
REVERT RISK: if ghost windows reappear during taskkill teardown, revert to IntPtr.Zero and file a new suggest with repro steps.

RESOLVED 2026-05-20: commit 656f8e120 removed WS_EX_TRANSPARENT from SourceInitialized exStyle, commit d4a377884 keyword anchor. Evidence: test-eye-tick-callout-topmost-hwnd.sh. Suggest resolved to history.
